description: This file defines a minimal API endpoint class 'CatalogBrandListEndpoint' that handles GET requests to list catalog brands, utilizing dependency injection of AutoMapper and a repository interface to fetch data and produce a response.

classes.name: CatalogBrandListEndpoint
classes.description: An API endpoint class for listing catalog brands, implementing the IEndpoint interface.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Configures the route for the GET request to 'api/catalog-brands', mapping it to the handler method.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Handles the request by fetching catalog brands from the repository, mapping them to DTOs, and returning the response.
